notes.title: First Major Content Update
notes.notes:
Hello Players!

We have just released the first major content update for influence!  In addition to  improving multiplayer stability, you are now able to [b]export saved songs[/b] in mp3 format.  Have a listen to one I made this morning [url=www.playinfluence.com/downloads/SymphonyOfSilence.mp3]here[/url].
